benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The Binder source gate stands. The |J|-max confirmation on k=44..55 is not rerun.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..55 were used in earlier rounds; 68 and above stay unused; k=100 and 101 were round-1 held-out instances and are not used
forbidden: choosing interleaved or Fiedler after seeing which N won

families.nodata: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 1+3L, seed provider
families.K: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 2+3L, seed provider
families.nodata_fid: shared gamma on the Fiedler triples, seed provider
families.K_fid: shared gamma on those triples, seed provider
families.KM_fid: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, three shell angles per layer, Fiedler triple partition. 3+3L. Same UcX at every layer.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-3 standard budget

packing_rule: One rule at every N. A_ij = |J_ij| for i not equal j, zero diagonal, symmetrized. Laplacian L = diag(A 1) - A. Take the eigenvector of the second-smallest eigenvalue from numpy.linalg.eigh. Abort if the gap from that eigenvalue to the next is below 1e-8. Flip the sign so the entry of largest magnitude is positive, breaking magnitude ties by the smallest site index. Order sites by (Fiedler coordinate, site index). The cavities are the contiguous triples of that order. Store each triple sorted, and store the list of triples sorted. The same partition is used at every layer. K is the original pair-square of the full J. M is the original block mean of this partition. The intra-triple |J| sum is recorded and is not the objective.
architecture: cavity X frame, start |+> in the logical simulator which is |0>^N then W, repeat UcX = W D W then popcount shellSNAP, final W included in the logical trailing transform. One gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM for all layers. Three shell angles per layer.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]

seeds.note: Same integer prefixes as the round-4 runner, which this round calls. The instance index k is inside every seed, and k=56..67 were not fit before, so these are not earlier draws. family_index is the position in family_order of this protocol.

continuation: KM and KM_fid: Zhou interpolation of the shells with the shared coefficients kept, time-rescaled coefficients times (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3), two ramps, nested seed from K or K_fid. QAOA: Zhou interpolation, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, and the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05).
selection: lowest energy within a repeat; the reported state is the lower of the two repeats. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in packing, features, starts, beam, or selection. The claim is KM_fid. The interleaved and Fiedler states are not compared in order to keep one of them.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 complete instances

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats inner
